fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CHANNEL TYPE (ATM, POS, MPOS OR QR)
fields.description: Channel (Terminal) type with possible options as ATM, POS, MPOS or QR Codes

fields.name: CARD BRAND TYPE
fields.description: E.g. VISA, MasterCard, American Express, Interswitch, Ken Switch, China Union Pay, Other acquiring brands.

fields.name: CURRENCY OF TRANSACTION
fields.description: Currency of transaction either Local or Foreign {ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: NUMBER OF TRANSACTIONS
fields.description: Number of transactions done using foreign issued cards over the reporting period

fields.name: VALUE OF TRANSACTIONS
fields.description: Value of transactions done using foreign issued cards over the reporting period in local currency equivalent
